latest_release.name: Claude Obsidian v3.0.1 - Original Plugin Name Restored
latest_release.body:
Claude Obsidian v3.0.1 restores the Claude plugin name `claude-obsidian`, so commands are `/claude-obsidian:*` again. Version 3.0.0 had renamed the plugin to `agricidaniel-obsidian`, which changed every command. Nothing else changes: all of the [3.0.0 hardening](https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian/releases/tag/v3.0.0) is included.

## Upgrading

**From 2.x**, this is an ordinary update and your commands never change:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace update agricidaniel-claude-obsidian
claude plugin update claude-obsidian@agricidaniel-claude-obsidian
```

**From 3.0.0** (`agricidaniel-obsidian`), the marketplace update moves your settings back, then install once:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace update agricidaniel-claude-obsidian
claude plugin install claude-obsidian@agricidaniel-claude-obsidian
```

Restart Claude Code after either path. Managed settings that name `agricidaniel-obsidian` need the key changed by hand. See the [namespace guide](https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian/blob/v3.0.1/docs/namespace-migration.md).

## Why the name works

Claude Code installs and loads `claude-obsidian` normally. Its validator reports names that start with `claude-` as reserved, and `claude plugin tag` refuses them, so keeping the name the community knows is a deliberate exception. The project's own package validator accepts `claude-obsidian` and still rejects every other reserved name.

## Verification

- 12 of 12 GitHub checks passed on the `main` merge commit: Ubuntu and macOS on Python 3.11 to 3.14, the Windows portable surface, the reproducible release artifact gate and CodeQL. The release PR ran the same matrix green.
- With Claude Code 2.1.306 in isolated configs, against a marketplace that moved between the v2.2.0, 3.0.0 and 3.0.1 trees: a 2.2.0 install updated to 3.0.1 with its enabled setting unchanged, and a 3.0.0 install had its setting moved back and reinstalled as 3.0.1 with one command.
- In a live session, all 15 skills and 3 agents load under `claude-obsidian:`.
- `make test`, package validation and the release tests passed. `claude plugin validate` reports one error, the reserved name.
- Final archive built twice from merge commit `6414e1a232a00515dc0b89f61b1d792b3dc93237` and matched byte for byte.
